# exec.test passes or fails by exit status, and `results` maps the command's
# JSON output to suites and tests, shown as `report` selects.
bit plain_pass
stdout '^plain_pass ✔ ok$'

! bit plain_fail
stdout '^plain_fail │ broken$'
stdout '^plain_fail ✘ tests failed$'
stderr '^error: BUILD\.bit:\d+:1: test target ''plain_fail'' failed$'

# Tests already running when one fails still finish, and the error names
# every test that failed.
! bit -j2 plain_fail also_fails
stdout '^ *also_fails ✘ tests failed$'
stdout '^ *plain_fail ✘ tests failed$'
stderr '^error: 2 test targets failed:\n  BUILD\.bit:\d+:1: ''also_fails''\n  BUILD\.bit:\d+:1: ''plain_fail''$'

# suites, the default: a line per suite. Logs of passing tests are hidden.
bit suites
stdout '^suites ✔ PASS math \(\d+ms, 1 passed, 1 skipped\)$'
stdout '^suites ✔ PASS strings \(\d+ms, 1 passed\)$'
! stdout 'adds'
! stdout 'adding numbers'
! stdout 'a plain log line'

# tests: a line per test.
bit tests
stdout '^tests ✔ PASS math/adds \(500ms\)$'
stdout '^tests · SKIP math/skips$'
stdout '^tests ✔ PASS strings/joins \(250ms\)$'
! stdout 'PASS math \('
! stdout 'adding numbers'

# verbose: a line per test, and logs as they arrive.
bit verbose
stdout '^verbose │ adding numbers\n(.*\n)?verbose ✔ PASS math/adds \(500ms\)$'
stdout '^verbose │ a plain log line$'
stdout '^verbose ✔ PASS strings/joins \(250ms\)$'

# A failed test fails the target, though the command succeeded, and shows
# its logs.
cp failing.jsonl results.jsonl
! bit suites
stdout '^suites ✘ FAIL math \(\d+ms, 1 passed, 1 failed\)$'
stdout '^suites ┆   divides \(100ms\)$'
stdout '^suites ┆     division by zero$'
stdout '^suites ✔ PASS strings \(\d+ms, 1 passed\)$'
stdout '^suites ✘ tests failed$'
! stdout 'adding numbers'

! bit tests
stdout '^tests ✘ FAIL math/divides \(100ms\)$'
stdout '^tests ┆   division by zero$'
stdout '^tests ✔ PASS math/adds \(500ms\)$'

# A failed test runs again, though nothing changed.
! bit suites
stdout '^suites ▶ .*\(previously failed\)$'

# A failing exit status fails the target, though every test passed.
! bit exit_fails
stdout '^exit_fails ✔ PASS only/one'
stdout '^exit_fails ✘ '

-- BUILD.bit --
let filter = <<-EOF
  {suite: .s}
    + (if .t then {name: .t} else {} end)
    + (if .o then {output: .o} else {} end)
    + (if .st then {status: .st, duration: .d} else {} end)
EOF

plain_pass = exec.test { command = "echo fine" }
plain_fail = exec.test { command = "echo broken; exit 1" }
also_fails = exec.test { command = "exit 1" }

suites = exec.test {
  command = "cat results.jsonl"
  inputs = ["results.jsonl"]
  results = filter
}

tests = exec.test {
  command = "cat results.jsonl"
  inputs = ["results.jsonl"]
  results = filter
  report = "tests"
}

verbose = exec.test {
  command = "cat results.jsonl"
  inputs = ["results.jsonl"]
  results = filter
  report = "verbose"
}

exit_fails = exec.test {
  command = "echo '{\"s\":\"only\",\"t\":\"one\",\"st\":\"pass\",\"d\":0}'; exit 1"
  results = filter
  report = "tests"
}
-- results.jsonl --
{"s":"math","t":"adds","o":"adding numbers\n"}
{"s":"math","t":"adds","st":"pass","d":0.5}
{"s":"math","t":"skips","st":"skip","d":0}
a plain log line
{"s":"strings","t":"joins","st":"pass","d":0.25}
{"s":"math","st":"pass","d":1}
{"s":"strings","st":"pass","d":1}
-- failing.jsonl --
{"s":"math","t":"adds","o":"adding numbers\n"}
{"s":"math","t":"adds","st":"pass","d":0.5}
{"s":"math","t":"divides","o":"division by zero\n"}
{"s":"math","t":"divides","st":"fail","d":0.1}
a plain log line
{"s":"strings","t":"joins","st":"pass","d":0.25}
{"s":"math","st":"fail","d":1}
{"s":"strings","st":"pass","d":1}
